parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can specify up to 50 instances in a single request. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query.

Maximum value: 50.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description:
The plugin name. The full character set is supported. The name can be up to 255 characters in length.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the status of all installed plugins on the instance is queried.

    > If you do not specify this parameter, you can specify only one instance ID.

- If you specify this parameter, the status of the specified plugin on the instances is queried.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. Set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to go offline. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform a paging query instead.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: > This parameter is about to go offline. Use NextToken and MaxResults to perform a paging query instead.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
